scripts.build:angular: pnpm run build:library && pnpm --filter ng-primeui build
scripts.build:react: pnpm run build:library && pnpm --filter react-primeui build
scripts.build:vue: pnpm run build:library && pnpm --filter vue-primeui build
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:library && pnpm -r --parallel --if-present run dev
scripts.dev:angular: pnpm run build:library && pnpm --filter ng-primeui dev
scripts.dev:react: pnpm run build:library && pnpm --filter react-primeui dev
scripts.dev:vue: pnpm run build:library && pnpm --filter vue-primeui dev
scripts.lint:vue: pnpm --filter vue-primeui exec oxlint . && pnpm --filter vue-primeui exec eslint .
scripts.check:angular: pnpm run build:angular && pnpm run test:angular
scripts.check:react: pnpm run build:react && pnpm run lint:react
scripts.check:vue: pnpm run build:vue && pnpm run test:vue && pnpm run lint:vue
scripts.check:backend: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run lint:backend
scripts.check: pnpm run check:library && pnpm run check:angular && pnpm run check:react && pnpm run check:vue && pnpm run check:backend
